eventScripts.script:
if not initialChange and currentValue.quality.isGood() and previousValue.quality.isGood() and currentValue.value != previousValue.value and currentValue.value > 0 and currentValue.value is not None:
		newValue = currentValue.value
		prevValue = previousValue.value or 0.0	

		if currentValue.timestamp > previousValue.timestamp: deltaValue = newValue - prevValue if newValue > prevValue else newValue
		elif currentValue.timestamp < previousValue.timestamp: deltaValue = prevValue - newValue if prevValue > newValue else prevValue
		else: return
		
		countInfo = {
						'counterId': system.tag.read("[.]counterId").value,
						'itemId': system.tag.read("[.]itemId").value,
						'workOrderId': system.tag.read("[.]workOrderId").value,
						'itemStateId': system.tag.read("[.]itemStateId").value,
						'deltaValue': deltaValue,
						'tStamp': currentValue.timestamp,
					}
		
		userId = None
		system.kanoa.event.addCounterEvent(countInfo, userId)
		
		return

log = system.util.getLogger('kanoa_tags')
	
	if not currentValue.value:
		parentTagPath = tagPath.rsplit('/', 1)[0]
		counterName = parentTagPath.rsplit('/', 1)[-1]
		assetTagPath = tagPath.rsplit('/', 2)[0]
		assetPath = assetTagPath.replace("/", "\\").replace('[Kanoa]', '')
		assetPath = assetPath.replace("\\counters", "")
		system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('assetId', system.kanoa.asset.getAssets({'assetPath': assetPath}))
		assetId = system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('assetId', system.kanoa.asset.getAssets({'assetPath': assetPath}))
		system.tag.write(parentTagPath + '/assetId', assetId)
		if assetId is None:
			log.trace("Invalid asset")
		else:
			counterType = system.tag.read(parentTagPath + '/counterType').value
			log.trace("Initializing counter instance %s %s"%(counterName, counterType))
			counterTypeId = system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('counterTypeId', system.kanoa.asset.getCounterType({'counterTypeName': counterType}))
			if counterTypeId:
				userId = system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('userId', system.kanoa.security.getUsers({'userName': 'SYSTEM'}))
				counterId = system.kanoa.asset.addCounter(assetId, counterName, counterType, userId)
				log.trace("Found counterId %s for %s"%(counterId, parentTagPath))
				system.tag.write(parentTagPath + '/counterId', counterId)
			else:
				log.trace("Invalid counter type")
		
	import time
	time.sleep(0.5)
	system.tag.write(tagPath, False)
	
	return
